entries.title: Philippians 3:1
segments: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not irksome, but for you it is safe.

entries.title: Philippians 3:2
segments: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the concision:

entries.title: Philippians 3:3
segments: for we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God, and glory in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh:

entries.title: Philippians 3:4
segments: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh: if any other man thinketh to have confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

entries.title: Philippians 3:5
segments: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

entries.title: Philippians 3:6
segments: as touching zeal, persecuting the church; as touching the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

entries.title: Philippians 3:7
segments: Howbeit what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 3:8
segments: Yea verily, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but refuse, that I may gain Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 3:9
segments: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of mine own, [even] that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith:

entries.title: Philippians 3:10
segments: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed unto his death;

entries.title: Philippians 3:11
segments: if by any means I may attain unto the resurrection from the dead.

entries.title: Philippians 3:12
segments: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect: but I press on, if so be that I may lay hold on that for which also I was laid hold on by Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 3:13
segments: Brethren, I could not myself yet to have laid hold: but one thing [I do], forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,

entries.title: Philippians 3:14
segments: I press on toward the goal unto the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 3:15
segments: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if in anything ye are otherwise minded, this also shall God reveal unto you:

entries.title: Philippians 3:16
segments: only, whereunto we have attained, by that same [rule] let us walk.

entries.title: Philippians 3:17
segments: Brethren, be ye imitators together of me, and mark them that so walk even as ye have us for an ensample.

entries.title: Philippians 3:18
segments: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, [that they are] the enemies of the cross of Christ:

entries.title: Philippians 3:19
segments: whose end is perdition, whose god is the belly, and [whose] glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.

entries.title: Philippians 3:20
segments: For our citizenship is in heaven; whence also we wait for a Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

entries.title: Philippians 3:21
segments: who shall fashion anew the body of our humiliation, [that it may be] conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working whereby he is able even to subject all things unto himself.
